snippet.title: Tame-a-goat-chi Early Access Announcement Video
snippet.description:
Tame-a-goat-chi is a cozy world of goats that live alongside your daily routine, gently unfolding at the bottom of your screen. You start with a small pasture and a few lovable goats, each with their own personality and moods. As you go about your day, they wander, play, and react to the world around them, turning your farm into a living, evolving space! 

Game link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757430/Tameagoatchi/
